queries.accounts: SELECT account_id, date AS opened_at FROM account ORDER BY account_id
queries.owners:
SELECT account_id, client_id FROM disp
                 WHERE type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY account_id
queries.transactions:
SELECT trans_id, account_id, date AS trans_date,
                            type, operation, k_symbol, amount, balance
                       FROM trans ORDER BY account_id, date, trans_id

run_manifest.target: recency(T)<=A then zero qualifying events in (T,T+H]
run_manifest.episode_key: account_id + last qualifying activity date known at T
run_manifest.population_filter_stage: before target construction and all splits/model fits
run_manifest.selection: validation AP, tie lower Brier, tie fixed candidate order
run_manifest.threshold: validation maximum F2, tie largest threshold; no validation positives -> predict none
run_manifest.unavailable_model_rule: single-class train: only prevalence; other families marked unavailable
run_manifest.single_class_validation_rule: select prevalence; no AP-based family selection is identifiable

bootstrap.method: unstratified percentile 95%, conditional on frozen fit/selection
